_comment: Banners sold direct (owner, 23 Sep 2026). Adding an advertiser means an entry in `ads` and a deploy; a slot with no live ad shows the house ad instead. Prices and the traffic figures on /advertise come from here, so the page can never disagree with what is sold. `statsAsOf` is the GA4 period the figures cover -- refresh it monthly with scripts/ga4-report.py.
